column1: # Security advisories for the Claude Code and Codex CLIs, from the GitHub
# security advisories of anthropics/claude-code and openai/codex, checked on
# the date in advisories.go. Only the npm CLI packages: the native installs
# are the same binary and version numbers. Desktop and IDE apps are left out,
# since jarx doesn't scan them. Ranges are space-separated constraints, all
# of which must hold. GHSA low shows as info, since jarx has no low.
